sources.label: CCAR-P guide, through Dec 6 (v1.1, Nov 2026; v1.0 July 2026 content)

items.after: 70 items: 60 scored, 10 unscored, unidentified
items.examImpact: Treat every item as scored; pace about 1m43s per item.

items.after: Scenario-based multiple-choice; each item states how many to select
items.examImpact: Practise reading a scenario first; multi-select may still appear.

items.after: Unchanged
items.examImpact: No change to timing strategy beyond more items.

items.after: None; CCAR-F recommended preparation
items.examImpact: Assume CCAR-F scope (agents, MCP, Claude Code, context) as known.
Largest domain; spend most study time here.
Governance gains most (+2); study compliance controls and injection.
Now smallest domain; SLAs, ADRs and handoff completeness need less time.
Dev productivity +1; model/prompt/context unchanged.

items.after: 39 named skills with descriptions, phrased as analyse/evaluate/select
items.examImpact: Expect diagnose-and-choose scenarios, not recall of definitions.

items.area: New: deployment surface and agent runtime
items.after: API vs Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry; Messages loop, Agent SDK, Managed Agents
items.examImpact: Learn trade-offs: data residency, session state, sandboxing, custody.

items.area: New: task delegation Claude vs humans
items.after: Assign steps by reversibility, stakes, accountability
items.examImpact: Practise justifying delegate, retain or collaborate per step.

items.after: Rate limits, retry/backoff, idempotency for side effects, fallback routing
items.examImpact: Know how to avoid duplicate effects (e.g. double payment) on retry.

items.area: New: cache breakpoints, effort, context lifecycle
items.after: Cache breakpoints; reasoning effort; context editing, memory tool, compaction
items.examImpact: Study stable-before-dynamic ordering and long-session strategies.

items.after: Pin, re-tune prompts, re-baseline evals or defer, using deprecation timeline
items.examImpact: Practise reading regression results against a deprecation date.

items.after: Position, verbosity, self-preference, judge drift; trials per case
items.examImpact: Know how to separate config effect from run-to-run variance.

items.after: Retrieved docs, tool results, MCP responses, third-party Skills
items.examImpact: Map untrusted entry points and the controls for each.

items.after: Architectural controls: residency, retention/ZDR, PII redaction, audit logs, tenant isolation
items.examImpact: Map an obligation to controls; do not memorise regulations.

items.before: RAG chunking; Claude Code for teams
items.after: Contextual retrieval; plugins, marketplaces, managed settings, permission modes
items.examImpact: Know the six permission modes and plugin distribution.

items.after: Control preserving human ownership of AI-generated code
items.examImpact: Study review gates and ownership for AI-assisted development.

items.after: 70 items: 60 scored, 10 unscored
items.examImpact: Treat every item as scored; about 1m43s per item.

items.after: Scenario-based MC; 120 min; $125; 720
items.examImpact: Timing unchanged; more items, so faster reading.
Largest cut (-13.1); API mechanics matter less, resilience more.
Biggest rise (+7.4); learn eval design and failure diagnosis.
Now about 5 items; know extension mechanisms and permission modes.
Study agent patterns, context management, grounding and structured output.

items.area: Domain: Model Selection; Security; Tools and MCP
items.examImpact: Model selection shrinks; security and tools roughly flat.

items.after: 8 domains weighted; skills unweighted
items.examImpact: Cover every skill evenly within a domain.

items.after: Golden sets, regression tests, LLM-judge calibrated to human labels
items.examImpact: Build a small eval and calibrate a judge.

items.after: Streaming terminal events; rate-limit, overloaded, invalid, timeout classes; Files API
items.examImpact: Know which Anthropic errors to retry and which to fix.

items.after: Answer from documents with citations; return 'not found'; full context vs retrieval
items.examImpact: Practise grounded requests and corpus-size trade-offs.

items.after: Choose Skill, plugin, rules, hook, subagent or command; package it
items.examImpact: Match each team workflow to the right mechanism.

items.after: Not named; managed sandboxed agent runtime vs self-hosted harness
items.examImpact: Drop framework trivia; learn managed vs self-hosted runtimes.

items.after: Cost diagnosis: dominant driver, layered/rolling cache breakpoints, batch
items.examImpact: Read usage data, find the cost driver, quantify the saving.

items.after: Unchanged; guide v1.1 edit was registration, ID and support wording
items.examImpact: No new study needed; same guide before and after Dec 7.

items.after: 70 items (60 scored), 120 min, $175, 720/1000; MC and multi-response
items.examImpact: Soft-launched Nov 2026; same guide before and after Dec 7.

items.after: 8: Orchestration 17, Integration 20, Observability 12, Debugging 10, Eval 12, Cost 8, Guardrails 11, Fleet Ops 10
items.examImpact: Production-scale focus: observability, incidents, fleet operations.
